author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0018366 chiral amino acid racemization and child terms GO:0019122 and GO:0018085
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/31180

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w03TWCsuNiFBQMnis_ufzymH9KcQLaIqkawHr2oPKEA/edit?usp=sharing

Impacted groups: 

UniProt 1

Mappings that need to be reviewed: 
term	file	line
GO:0019122	resid2go	RESID:AA0191 > GO:peptidyl-D-alanine racemization ; GO:0019122

Thanks.
